verdict.rationale: Ultrametric's CLI `init` command previews and then writes selected skill files into a project for Codex and Claude Code. The docs say these files can be committed to share the setup with the team, which matches the story's 'files committed to the project' path. Missing for 10: no documented plugin marketplace or centrally managed team-wide distribution, only thin documentation of how teams version and update committed skills, and no independent or hands-on corroboration. [2026-10-14 adversarial bias audit (owner-product refresh lane): reverted full 7 -> partial 5, restoring the 2026-10-08 audit parity: gstack's dedicated team tooling and superpowers' shared marketplace repo sit at partial 5, and the owner's only path is committing generated skill files, with no team tooling and no hands-on teammate pickup. The arena's fulls (anthropic-skills/codex-plugins 9, mattpocock-skills/skills-cli 8) stand on marketplace or registry distribution. Ultrametric-affiliation governance, README §9.]
